## BStringView  
  
A [`BStringView`](BStringView.md "BStringView") object draws a string that the user can neither select nor edit. [`BStringView`](BStringView.md "BStringView") objects are typically used as labels for your app's UI. If you need to present text that can be selected and/or edited, use a [`BTextView`](BTextView.md "BTextView") object.
